raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.11.6" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-learnr
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/learnr_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/learnr/learnr_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 41969b8fd7814773780940962ae2c631df365e883c0ec5248d8a0d6eee02c742

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-checkmate
    - r-curl
    - r-digest
    - r-ellipsis >=0.2.0.1
    - r-evaluate
    - r-htmltools >=0.3.5
    - r-htmlwidgets
    - r-jsonlite
    - r-knitr >=1.31
    - r-lifecycle
    - r-markdown
    - r-promises
    - r-rappdirs
    - r-renv >=0.8.0
    - r-rlang
    - r-rmarkdown >=1.12.0
    - r-rprojroot
    - r-shiny >=1.0
    - r-withr
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-checkmate
    - r-curl
    - r-digest
    - r-ellipsis >=0.2.0.1
    - r-evaluate
    - r-htmltools >=0.3.5
    - r-htmlwidgets
    - r-jsonlite
    - r-knitr >=1.31
    - r-lifecycle
    - r-markdown
    - r-promises
    - r-rappdirs
    - r-renv >=0.8.0
    - r-rlang
    - r-rmarkdown >=1.12.0
    - r-rprojroot
    - r-shiny >=1.0
    - r-withr

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('learnr')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('learnr')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://rstudio.github.io/learnr/
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_family: APACHE
  license_file: LICENSE-2.0.txt
  summary: Create interactive tutorials using R Markdown. Use a combination  of narrative, figures, videos, exercises, and quizzes to create self-paced tutorials for learning about R and R packages.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - oblute
    - benhuff
